LanguageData.RM_Settings_EasyMode: Easy mode (softer magnitudes, negatives fade faster)
LanguageData.RM_Settings_EasyModeHint: Tags still come only from deeds. Effects and decay are gentler.
LanguageData.RM_Settings_ChatSpreadHint: Only on real social interactions — no hourly all-colonist mesh.
LanguageData.RM_Settings_HookWar: War hero / Deserter (raid kills / panic flee)
LanguageData.RM_TagDesc_Reliable: Known for steady hands in the sick bay. People trust them with the wounded.
LanguageData.RM_TagDesc_BloodyHands: Word spreads about cold work with a knife — executions, harvests, malice.
LanguageData.RM_TagDesc_Squeamish: Has seen too much blood and freezes when the floor goes red.
LanguageData.RM_TagDesc_Nerved: Rumor says their nerves were opened on a table. Traders get uneasy.
LanguageData.RM_TagDesc_WarHero: Stood and killed when the raid came. The colony tells it with pride.
LanguageData.RM_TagDesc_Deserter: Broke and ran while the colony was under threat. Hard to forget.
